name: Dariusz Joński - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the accession of Vanuatu to the Interim Partnership Agreement between the European Community, of the one part, and the Pacific States, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament agrees that Vanuatu should join a trade agreement between the European Union and several Pacific countries. Vanuatu was removed from the list of poorest countries that get duty-free access to the EU market from 1 January 2025, because the World Bank now classes it as an upper middle-income country. Joining this agreement gives Vanuatu a new legal basis for trade with the EU and brings it into the shared rules and institutions the agreement sets up.

- Vanuatu joins the EU's interim trade agreement with Fiji, Papua New Guinea, Samoa and Solomon Islands.
- It affects Vanuatu, those Pacific countries, EU traders and EU member states.
- Parliament has given its consent; the Council can now adopt the decision.
